verdict.rationale: The Transfers docs describe API/SDK payouts from a custodial account to onchain addresses, email recipients, or bank accounts. They include upfront fee quotes and lifecycle tracking from initiation through completion or failure, and a guide covers paying out USDC onchain to any wallet. Webhooks with at-least-once delivery support status notifications. Missing for 10: an explicit stored/saved-recipient object (only email recipients are shown), detailed documentation of the status states down to final onchain settlement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
